description: e6 test effect (not a real plugin): the effect controls at every position. fn + blue gain (Q15 16384 = unity; 1365 a detent, shift + fn + blue 273: the ports' 0.5 / 0.1 dB steps), green click polarity (steps, saved), fn + white depth (unused, shown), orange click mute (a latch, not saved).
